recommendation: Keep the audit as-is; further core changes for FHIR-10649 would be redundant unless a separate work-group decision reintroduces ElementDefinition.name or changes sliceName semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-10649 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-core issue asking to fix the wrong short definition of ElementDefinition.name, which said "Name for this particular element definition (reference target)".
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-10649, but git commit c997080bc43c87c6a1c22e4ac6b06a2cb0cdcf40, imported from svn revision 10016 on 2016-10-18, renamed ElementDefinition.name to ElementDefinition.sliceName and changed the bad short definition to "Name for this particular element (in a set of slices)".
additional_context: The same svn revision is the explicit application for FHIR-12181, the related Published/Persuasive issue requesting the ElementDefinition.name to sliceName rename. FHIR-12181 is already represented on the combined branch, and current source/fhir.ini retains ElementDefinition.name only as a compatibility map to ElementDefinition.sliceName.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because current build-scope source already has the corrected ElementDefinition.sliceName definition and no stale live ElementDefinition.name definition remains.

related_jiras.note: Requested the ElementDefinition.name to ElementDefinition.sliceName rename that also removed the bad short definition; already represented on the combined branch by 4bb6884ed524003f50a7807d4b6ff7ad1f7980ad.
